Chapter 213: Chapter 12 Wanyang Same Heaven (Please Subscribe)

The Chikun Star Lord’s consciousness was vast, and in just a moment, he had viewed all of Lin Yuan’s recent challenge videos.

“My disciple…”

The Chikun Star Lord was filled with surprise and doubt.

“Has he begun the soul-fusing transformation?”

The others, including the twelve Peak Masters, all thought that Lin Yuan’s rapid cultivation was due to the good guidance of the Chikun Star Lord.

But the Chikun Star Lord knew better, as he had hardly provided any guidance to Lin Yuan.

...

When he learned that Lin Yuan had entered the Fifth Rank, the Chikun Star Lord abandoned the original training plan he had set for Lin Yuan.

He planned to first let Lin Yuan experience a ‘Rule Crystal,’ to sense and test its effects before deciding the next steps.

But now?

He was still waiting for Lin Yuan to feedback on the effects of the ‘Rule Crystal,’ and Lin Yuan had already completed the Fifth Rank, begun the soul-fusing transformation, and was about to step into the Sixth Rank?

“Eighty percent, no, at least ninety, ninety-five percent…”

Although the Chikun Star Lord was observing Lin Yuan through the Virtual World, his keen eyes could roughly discern Lin Yuan’s level.

Watching Lin Yuan battle other evolvers of the same level, he was almost certain that the soul-fusing transformation had reached at least ninety-five percent.

“Seems like you’re in a good mood lately…”

While the Chikun Star Lord was deep in thought, the white-robed man playing chess across from him glanced at him and said surprisingly.

He knew the Chikun Star Lord well enough to expect some gloating after learning his own disciple had outperformed the man’s own.

“Hahahaha.”

“My disciple, how could your disciple compare? Did he cry and come to you to complain? Hahahaha.”

The Chikun Star Lord realized this and immediately burst into laughter.

Although he knew he might have underestimated Lin Yuan’s true talent again, he seized the rare opportunity to once more outshine his friend.

“You, I thought you had changed…”

The white-robed man said helplessly, although he had also watched the battle videos of his disciple and Lin Yuan. Indeed, the Chikun Star Lord’s disciple had decisively overpowered his.

“Where on Earth did you find such an outstanding disciple?”

The white-robed man couldn’t help but ask.

The thirteen Peak Masters of the Red Kun Lineage claimed… it was discovered by the Chikun Star Lord during his travels in the universe on a certain planet.

Of course, this claim was not highly credible, but since it was asserted by the Chikun Star Lord himself, the white-robed man played along with the topic.

“This… this is a secret…”

The Chikun Star Lord smiled mysteriously, “You’ll know once my disciple steps into the Sixth Rank.”

“You old fox, still playing mysterious with me.”

The white-robed man teased, but did not pursue the topic further.

He indeed knew that thousands of years ago, the Chikun Star Lord’s newly acquired disciple was killed in an assassination by a different species because his identity was revealed.

Because of this, the Chikun Star Lord personally descended onto the Battlefields of Different Races, engaged in a frenzied slaughter for a while, and only then returned to Chikun Main Star.

…

Virtual World.

Battle Arena Region.

Every time it was almost time for Lin Yuan’s daily challenge, countless spectators would arrive early, filled with anticipation for the fight to start.

It was well known that Lin Yuan not only had the aura of being one of the thirteen Peak Masters from the Red Kun Lineage but had shown almost overwhelming strength in many of his past battles, drawing a large fan base.

These fans were not only limited to the Chikun Star Domain and its neighboring domains but also came from distant regions of human civilization.

So, for these fans, the status of the thirteen Peak Masters meant little; they valued Lin Yuan’s fighting style and strength more.

Inside the VIP box.

The Heiyu Mo from the Heiyu Family, a Seventh Rank Evolver, was sitting in his place.

Next to Heiyu Mo, there were other shadowy figures who were evidently friends of Heiyu Mo.

“What do you think? The strength of my Chikun Star Domain’s thirteen Peak Master, not bad, right?” Heiyu Mo said casually.

“Indeed, I had heard that the Chikun Star Lord was skilled in teaching his disciples, and now it seems, his reputation is well deserved.”

The first figure sitting to the right of Heiyu Mo nodded.

“Have you noticed? Every battle in the arena, the thirteen Peak Master’s abilities improve a bit. He’s using the other evolvers of the same level as stepping stones to ascend to the Sixth Rank…”

The figure on the left spoke.

He had intently watched every battle of the thirteen Peak Masters.

“Why else would so many people come to watch? The popularity of the arena where the thirteen Peak Master competes far surpasses that of the Sixth Rank arenas.”

Heiyu Mo paused, then continued.

“Throughout the ages, among those in our human civilization who evolved through continuous battle, deducing their own breakthroughs, not one was not a top-notch, stunningly talented genius.”

“The potential of the thirteen Peak Master is completely incalculable.”

Heiyu Mo stated.

“Indeed so.”

“But as for the future.”

“Who can know it?”

The other figures exchanged glances.

Potential and strength are completely different concepts.

If they could discern the potential of the thirteen Peak Masters, so could others, even those enemy different species.

“The future…”

“True, no one knows what the future holds…”

“Even those top ‘divination’ masters, the futures they foresee are only imagined, not unchangeable.”

Heiyu Mo looked down at the arena below, deep in thought.
